2607.01002.title: Logit-Contribution Scoring Identifies Non-Literal Retrieval Heads
2607.01002.paper_summary: In long-context use, large language models frequently synthesize answers from the meaning of a relevant context span rather than literally copy-pasting them. Identifying which attention heads perform this synthesis matters for interpreting long-context model behavior. Yet existing detectors miss these heads by construction: they reward heads whose attended token matches the generated token, a literal-copy criterion that captures where a head reads but not what it writes through its output-value (OV) circuit, the very mechanism that carries non-literal retrieval. We introduce Logit-Contribution Scoring (LOCOS), a write-aware detector that scores each head by the projection of its OV-circuit output onto the answer-token unembedding direction, contrasting needle and off-needle source positions in a single forward pass. Across three model families (Qwen3, Gemma-3, OLMo-3.1), mean-ablating the top LOCOS heads on the NoLiMa non-literal retrieval benchmark collapses ROUGE-L at lower head counts than prior attention-based detections; on Qwen3-8B, ablating 50 heads drives ROUGE-L from 0.401 to 0.000 while the strongest baseline still retains 0.292. The selected heads are retrieval-specific: parametric recall and arithmetic reasoning stay at baseline under the same ablation. On Qwen3-8B, the same ablation also drops MuSiQue from 0.55 to 0.08 and BABI-Long from 0.62 to 0.20, while a random-heads control stays within 0.05 of baseline.
2607.01002.paper_summary_zh: 在長上下文使用中，大型語言模型經常從相關上下文範圍的意義中合成答案，而不是字面上複製粘貼它們。識別哪些注意力頭執行這種合成對於解釋長上下文模型行為至關重要。 然而，現有的檢測器在結構上錯過了這些頭：它們獎勵那些其關注的標記與生成的標記匹配的頭，這是一種字面複製標準，捕捉到頭部讀取的位置，但未能捕捉到其通過輸出值（OV）電路所寫的內容，這正是承載非字面檢索的機制。我們引入了Logit-Contribution Scoring（LOCOS），這是一種寫入感知的檢測器，通過其OV電路輸出在答案標記去嵌入方向上的投影來為每個頭打分，在單次前向傳遞中對比針頭和非針頭源位置。在三個模型系列（Qwen3、Gemma-3、OLMo-3.1）中，對NoLiMa非字面檢索基準上最高的LOCOS頭進行平均消融，在比先前基於注意力的檢測更低的頭數下崩潰ROUGE-L；在Qwen3-8B上，消融50個頭使ROUGE-L從0.401降至0.000，而最強的基線仍保留0.292。所選的頭是檢索特定的：在相同的消融下，參數回憶和算術推理保持在基線水平。在Qwen3-8B上，相同的消融還使MuSiQue從0.55降至0.08，BABI-Long從0.62降至0.20，而隨機頭控制保持在基線的0.05範圍內。
